name: Panes
description: A collection of Pane objects that represent the slide, outline, and notes panes in the document window for normal view, or the single pane of any other view in the document window.
remarks: In normal view, the Panes collection contains three members. All other document window views have only a single pane, resulting in a Panes collection with one member.
example:
With ActiveWindow

    If .Panes.Count = 1 Then

        .ViewType = ppViewNormal

        .SplitHorizontal = 15

    End If

End With

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single Pane object from the specified Panes collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the single Pane object in the collection to be returned.
